summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin page is a web form that provides a user interface for staff administrators in the HSPnet system.
purpose: To allow staff administrators to view and manage employment applications and handle various admin tasks.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select site and discipline through dropdowns.
Click on 'Refresh View' button to load applications.

business_rules: Show withdrawn applications if the corresponding checkbox is checked.
validations: Date fields must pass regular expression validation.
conditions: Display error messages if any validation fails.
system_behavior: Auto-generates fields like valEndDate and txtEndDate.
